business_problem: Capita wanted to improve the efficiency of its labor-intensive recruitment process to help its customers fill roles faster. Capita's contact center job listings attract tens of thousands of applications.
solution_summary: Agentforce powers high-volume recruiting. As a digital workforce, Agentforce , Salesforce’s Digital Labor Platform, will help Capita quickly transform the recruitment process by autonomously taking action on early-stage tasks, such as enabling candidates to find jobs that fit their needs, assessing thousands of resumes in seconds, and narrowing the candidate pool for a potential match. Agentforce will interact with candidates in natural language and suggest the most relevant openings for them. For example, a recent college graduate might come to Capita’s website looking for a position. Agentforce will ask what they’re looking for, prompt them to upload their CV, instantly analyze it, and suggest relevant roles. Once they apply, Agentforce can then suggest next steps for the human recruiter, helping them move qualified candidates through the hiring process faster‌ — ‌a significant advantage for businesses that need to keep thousands of roles filled or staff up quickly for holiday.

solution_components.name: Agentforce
solution_components.role: Runs the AI agent workflows that screen candidates, recommend roles, and orchestrate high-volume recruiting.

solution_components.name: Einstein AI
solution_components.role: Generates recommendations, summaries, and content that help teams screen candidates, recommend roles, and orchestrate high-volume recruiting faster.

solution_components.name: Data Cloud
solution_components.role: Unifies enterprise and behavioral data so teams can screen candidates, recommend roles, and orchestrate high-volume recruiting with current context.

solution_components.name: Sales Cloud
solution_components.role: Stores account, opportunity, and workflow data teams use to screen candidates, recommend roles, and orchestrate high-volume recruiting.

solution_components.name: Service Cloud
solution_components.role: Stores cases, knowledge, and service context that supports teams as they screen candidates, recommend roles, and orchestrate high-volume recruiting.

solution_components.name: MuleSoft
solution_components.role: Connects external systems and APIs required to screen candidates, recommend roles, and orchestrate high-volume recruiting.
